findings.evidence: `unitSignature` has codomain `{w // w.IsReal} → ℝˣ ⧸ Units.posSubgroup ℝ` at Units/Signature.lean:82–84, while the proved index and equivalence use `fieldSignatures K` at NarrowClassGroup/Signature.lean:124–136; lines 39–42 explicitly state that surjectivity onto the full sign group is not proved.
findings.fix: Describe this as the relative quotient/cokernel among attainable signatures, or define a corestricted unit-signature map into `fieldSignatures K` and name its cokernel.
findings.issue: Lines 15, 50–52, and 121–123 call `fieldSignatures K / unitSignatures K` “the cokernel of the unit signature,” but `unitSignature` maps into the full sign group, so its cokernel is the full sign group modulo `unitSignatures K`; no surjectivity of `fieldUnitSignature` is established.

findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 119–127 define the two ranges, whereas `unitSignature` itself retains the larger ambient sign-group codomain at lines 82–84.
findings.fix: Replace “cokernel” with “relative signature quotient/index,” or explicitly refer to the signature map corestricted to `fieldSignatures K`.
findings.issue: The added module overview likewise says “the cokernel of the signature is an index of one [range] in the other,” conflating the map’s full-codomain cokernel with the relative index of `unitSignatures` in `fieldSignatures`.

summary: The documentation repeatedly identifies a relative quotient of attainable signatures with the cokernel of the existing unit-signature map, whose codomain is the full sign group.
